initial_scope: All 12 domains and every source branch classified. One substantive reviewed selected mechanism per domain is the minimum, not whole-society numerical completeness. Offline M2 is an intermediate milestone; complete release includes M3–M7 and optional BYOK.

DOM-01.branches: production; distribution/logistics; consumption, waste and circular loops.
DOM-01.origin: synthetic educational fixture; not a required starting civic policy
DOM-01.model_status: planned numerical/procedural; no implemented behavior claimed
DOM-01.evidence_status: hypothetical; independent synthetic oracle required before activation; empirical effects require separate source review
DOM-01.static_minimum: Two local groups/scopes, boundary/overlap, finite shared input, trace, shortage/missing/conflict and counterpart fixtures. At least one executable mechanism; text or schema alone fails.
DOM-01.transition_minimum: Declare supported lifecycle/schedule behavior and implement it with shared reducer/replay, or explicitly classify unsupported effects as gaps without inventing delays.
